title: NFL Secret Superstars: 3 under-the-radar AFC standouts in Week 8

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Secret Superstars: 3 under-the-radar AFC standouts in Week 8
sources.description: Emmett Johnson gave the Chiefs 143 yards against Denver, Braelon Allen is forcing missed tackles at a Jahmyr Gibbs rate, and Jacob Martin pressured Joe Burrow ceaselessly even without Jeffery Simmons beside him.
